newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Wednesday:

Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said the Commission would meet at 1500/1300 GMT in Strasbourg. He said the Commission was likely to take a decision to send humanitarian aid to Iran after the recent earthquake.

Spokesman Jean-Christophe Filori briefed on Wednesday and Thursday's Research Council. He said discussions would focus on structural dialogue with associated central and eastern European countries regarding the fifth framework programme. He said ministers would also debate the objectives, the structure, the actions, the implementation and the financing of the fifth framework programme.
In answer to a question spokesman Peter Jorgensen said the Commission had not been able to take a decision on the Austrian ban on genetically modified maize.

Spokesman Willy Helin said Commissioner Karel Van Miert disregarded rumours and comments that the merger between Boeing and McDonnell Douglas could trigger a transatlantic trade war and found them totally nonsensical. Helin added that it was wrong to envisage catastrophe scenarios at this stage since there were still more than two months of discussions and contacts ahead.

Helin confirmed that fines were possible under Article 14 and 15 of the merger regulation. He said these fines could reach 10 percent of a company's global turnover and that daily penalties were also foreseen.
Vale de Almeida said Commission President Jacques Santer had sent a telegram of condolences to Iranian President Akbar Hashemi-Rafsanjani following the earthquake that hit Iran on Saturday.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/401: Padraig Flynn comments on Eurostat figures on Income Distribution and Poverty.
- IP/97/404: Commission helps New Independent States (NIS) get oil and gas flowing: ECU 12 million committed this year.
- Eurostat - Statistics in focus - Energy and Industry No 1997-5: Electricity statistics for 1996.
- Eurostat - Statistics in focus - Energy and Industry No 1997-6: Extracts from "Monthly panorama of European Industry 4/97".
- Eurostat - Statistics in focus - Agriculture, forestry and fisheries No 1997-7: Trends in EU agricultural price indices in the fourth quarter of 1996.
- Eurostat - Statistics in focus - Population and social conditions No 1997-6: Income distribution and poverty in EU12 - 1993.
- Taxes and duties at April 1997 - National currencies and Ecus.
